subject: Re: Post-call MAP & procurement path for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP and next steps

Hi Alex — great to meet virtually this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed mutual action plan (attached) so we’re aligned on owners and timing. Key points we heard:

- Economic buyer: Dana Lopez (VP, IT) — decision window end of Q2 (around late June).
- Procurement steps: vendor security review, followed by SOW and legal review. Procurement contact appears to be Kate Walsh (contracts).
- Success criteria: (1) sub-200ms 95th latency on typical patient-summary workload, (2) on-prem deployment option for PHI datasets, (3) predictable cost per 1k tokens.

What I’m attaching: redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (draft milestones + owners) and a filled template for the security questionnaire we discussed. Please confirm whether the technical deep-dive with Rafael should be a hands-on demo (recommended) or a recorded run-through.

Proposed next steps:
- Alex to confirm economic buyer and procurement contacts (Dana + Kate) — target by 2026-03-05.
- Redwood: Rafael to deliver technical deep-dive and SRE Q&A (week of 3/8).
- Redwood: send updated MAP with firm dates + simple pilot scope by 3/4.
- Acme: start vendor security review upon receipt of the questionnaire (we’ll be available for any clarifying answers).

If that looks good I’ll send the MAP link and raise the SOW conversation with legal.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

Attachments: redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf), acme-security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP and next steps

Marissa — nice summary. A few internal notes on stakeholders and asks: 

- Dana Lopez (economic buyer) — fiscal approver; interested in TCO model and how Dedicated vs Private would affect OPEX vs CAPEX. Connor to own TCO worksheet for the deal.
- Kate Walsh (procurement) — will want standard security artifacts (SOC2, encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM notes) and a sample DPA. Laura, can you prep a short checklist we can hand Kate?
- Rafael: target the 60–90 min hands-on deep-dive that covers on-prem deployment topology, network reqs, and KV cache behavior. Make sure to capture a short list of required firewall rules and expected disk/GPU sizing for the pilot.

I’ll also add a simple timeline into the MAP and flag risk items (legal redline cadence, pilot data scope).

Connor
Account Strategy — Redwood Inference

Cc: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Kate Walsh <kate.walsh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few items from our side:

- Confirmed: Dana is the economic approver and will be the final sign-off. I’ve looped her and Kate (procurement) as requested.
- Procurement process: we run vendor security review first (timeline 2–3 weeks once questionnaire returned), then pricing/PO and legal redline. Kate will want the SOC2 and a filled questionnaire; happy to take the questionnaire you attached and route internally.
- Pilot: we prefer a short on-prem pilot (2 weeks) using de-identified records if that works for Redwood.

I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire our procurement team requires (vendor-questionnaire-acme.pdf). Kate — can you confirm expected review SLAs once we receive the filled questionnaire?

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Health
alex.jenkins@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-0123

Attachments: vendor-questionnaire-acme.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Kate Walsh <kate.walsh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 12:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP and next steps

Thanks Alex — really helpful. I uploaded an editable MAP and milestone tracker here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-map. I updated dates based on your procurement timeline and made the following assignments:

- Fill security questionnaire: Marissa (RWI) — ETA: 2026-03-04 (attachment sent earlier; we will also sync with Kate directly).
- Technical deep-dive + pilot runbook: Rafael (RWI) — proposed week of 2026-03-08; recommended 60–90m hands-on session.
- Legal/SOW and sample DPA: Laura (RWI) — will prepare a SOW template and sample DPA for Kate by 2026-03-10.
- Economic model/TCO: Connor (RWI) — will deliver a simple TCO comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private by 2026-03-11.
- Acme internal: Alex to confirm pilot data scope and Dana to confirm procurement timing by 2026-03-05.

Also shared a DocuSign link to an initial NDA/SOW stub to speed legal review: https://app.docusign.com/some/sow-link-ACME-042.

Next immediate ask to Alex/Kate/Dana: confirm whether Kate prefers questionnaires returned as PDF or an updated XLSX (we can send either). Also, please confirm the best time slot next week for Rafael to run the technical deep-dive (mornings ET are usually best for your team).

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Marissa / Alex — thanks. Quick notes from procurement:

- We prefer questionnaires returned as PDF (filled and signed where required) — please attach SOC2 cert and DPA sample.
- Typical internal SLA for vendor review is 10 business days once complete artifacts are submitted. If you can return the questionnaire by 3/4, goal is to finish review by 3/18.
- Pilot approvals: Dana will confirm budget line and pilot scope (expected this week).
